purpose: Grid container that arranges a set of statistic tiles into a responsive multi-column layout with shared labelling.
useWhen: Showing a row of related statistic tiles such as the top metrics of a dashboard.
Giving a cluster of statistic entries a single accessible group label.
Setting one quiet stat in the page flow under a spotlight, with variant plain.

avoidWhen.reason: Rendering exactly one metric at full size — use statistic on its own.
Building a freeform card grid unrelated to numeric metrics — compose surface or grid-list directly.
